coverage.units: native factor units; realized variance is squared-return scale

continuous_remainder.en-US: RV minus RJV for an additive display; it is not the raw IVhat estimate.
continuous_remainder.zh-CN: 用于加总展示的 RV 减 RJV；不等同于原始 IVhat 估计。

correlation.en-US: Same-date cross-sectional Spearman correlation, averaged with equal weight per date.
correlation.zh-CN: 同日横截面 Spearman 秩相关，并按日期等权平均。

median_observation_jump_share.en-US: Median of eligible stock-day RJV / RV ratios; each stock-day has equal weight.
median_observation_jump_share.zh-CN: 合格股票日 RJV / RV 比值的中位数；每个股票日等权。

pooled_jump_share.en-US: Sum of retained RJV divided by sum of RV for eligible stock-days.
pooled_jump_share.zh-CN: 合格股票日中 RJV 总和除以 RV 总和。

positive_residual_prevalence.en-US: Share of eligible stock-days with retained RJV greater than zero; not an event frequency.
positive_residual_prevalence.zh-CN: 合格股票日中 RJV 大于零的比例；不是事件发生频率。

rv_shape_closeness.en-US: Rolling RV-shape energy summary; higher-order shape statistics can be sensitive to extremes.
rv_shape_closeness.zh-CN: 滚动 RV 形态能量汇总；高阶形态统计可能受极端值影响。

rv_shape_h3.en-US: Rolling H3 shape of the realized-variance time series, not daily-return skewness.
rv_shape_h3.zh-CN: 实现方差时间序列的滚动 H3 形态，不是日收益偏度。

rv_shape_h4.en-US: Rolling H4 shape of the realized-variance time series, not daily-return kurtosis.
rv_shape_h4.zh-CN: 实现方差时间序列的滚动 H4 形态，不是日收益峰度。

en-US: The source is an archived panel ending 2026-04-24; it is not current-market data or point-in-time qualified.
RV-shape H3/H4/closeness are distinct rolling realized-variance measures, not daily-return moments or the missing daily-close Hermite output.
Positive RJV prevalence is not a calibrated jump-event frequency or event count.
Same-date correlations and sensitivity comparisons do not establish incremental prediction, causality, or return performance.
No portfolio or execution validation is included; incomplete rolling history remains missing.
zh-CN: 来源是截至 2026-04-24 的归档面板，不是当前市场数据，也未取得点时资格。
RV 形态 H3/H4/接近度是独立的滚动实现方差指标，不是日收益矩，也不是缺失的日收盘 Hermite 输出。
RJV 为正的比例不是经过校准的跳跃事件频率或事件数。
同日相关和敏感性比较不能证明增量预测力、因果关系或收益表现。
没有组合或执行验证；滚动历史不足时保留缺失。
